verdict.rationale: The Bitbucket product page says you can "Access the latest models with Rovo — in your terminal," which implies an official first-party terminal tool aimed at AI-assisted workflows. It is a single thin marketing line, with no named CLI, commands, install docs, or evidence that it operates on Bitbucket repos or PRs. The MCP server is a separate story and is not credited here. missing for 10: a named and documented official CLI, install and command reference, evidence that the CLI manages Bitbucket resources (repos/PRs/pipelines), hands-on or independent corroboration.
